<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class Note { public string $text = 'first'; }
class Box {
    public function __construct(public Note $note) {}
    public function __clone(): void { $this->note = clone $this->note; }
}
$first = new Box(new Note());
$second = clone $first;
$second->note->text = 'second';
echo $first->note->text, ' ', $second->note->text, "\n";
